mutations.name: removed lines are read from the head side

mutations.replace: const removed = numbered(after, edits.removed, keyLines(key, file.path, after));
kills: ciPolicyChanges shows a permission scope narrowed from write to read as a removed and an added line
ciPolicyChanges swapping base and head swaps removed and added

mutations.name: matchers read lines before escapes are stripped
kills: ciPolicyChanges strips an ANSI escape, a bidi override and a zero-width space from an author's head line and its path

mutations.name: the per-file line budget is never spent
kills: ciPolicyChanges caps a file at one line budget shared by its keys and counts the lines it left out

mutations.name: a bare CR does not split a line
kills: ciPolicyChanges splits at a bare CR as YAML does, so a job joined onto one line cannot hide its write-all behind a decoy edit

mutations.name: line and paragraph separators do not split a line
kills: ciPolicyChanges splits at a line or paragraph separator and strips one from a path, so neither can fake an unprefixed card line
